metadata.hardwareEvidence: none — cEOS-lab container capture; not DCS-7050TX-64 / 4.28.13.1M evidence (DR-043)
metadata.transport: https + HTTP basic auth to the run-owned published loopback port; container-side pinned certificate
redactionApplied: username/secret and enable/passphrase text replaced with <redacted-lab-secret>, including the encryption-type form (`secret sha512 <hash>`, `enable algorithm <algo> password <hash>`) and **object keys**, because `show running-config` in `json` format keys its `cmds` map by the whole command line — the lab `username … secret sha512 $6$…` line is a key there, not a value (observed 2026-11-06)
this run's random lab username replaced with <redacted-lab-user> (API user-stats otherwise leak it)

every MAC-shaped string under a *mac*-named key zeroed, at any depth (M12c: `show interfaces` / `show port-channel detail` carry a MAC per interface, not only systemMacAddress/hwMacAddress/configMacAddress)
no key material: the container keeps the key in a sibling file (capikey.pem) that is never read
serialNumber is the empty string on this cEOS-lab image and is kept verbatim
